# Color output register-raster capture

The twelve SPIR-V, Cross JSON and translated MSL files are original outputs for the canonical color-output and encode vertex/fragment stages. Their hashes, captured HLSL source hash, pinned tool identities and compiler policy are recorded in the portable provenance file. No machine-specific paths, AIR or ephemeral HLSL source are included.

The scene-output fragment has three readonly float2D images and two independent samplers. SceneColor uses Load and has no sampler. The readonly ExposureWords buffer uses the existing uint Reference schema; the uniform buffer has three float4 fields. The encode fragment uses one loaded image with no sampler. Each real vertex entry uses uint vertex_id and creates no logical vertex attribute.

These fixtures establish parser inputs, not GPU output or cook-trust qualification. Tests use the canonical product recipe and mutate copies only for negative cases. All original evidence files remain unchanged. The source includes analytic code generated by OpenColorIO 2.5.0; its BSD-3-Clause notices remain applicable, alongside the pinned tools' own licenses.

The existing register-raster normalizer consumes same-operation Cross JSON and selected-entry MSL. The original validated SPIR-V is preserved for provenance; this suite does not claim a separate binary validator. Unspecified SPIR-V depth classification is resolved by the actual ordinary texture2D JSON and nondepth float2D MSL declarations, with no fabricated depth or pairing metadata.
